text:
Storm Ledger Unit (fictional research unit)

The Storm Ledger Unit studies mid-century harbor weather reporting. The unit office is Room 108 in the West Archive wing. Weekly seminar: Tuesday 10:00–11:00 in Seminar Hut A.

The unit's holdings cover 1940–1975 and include 214 digitized station reports. Records for 1955 are complete and are the unit's most requested series. The unit holds nothing before 1940.

Lead archivist: Ana Ferreira. Student liaison: Tom Baptiste. Interview requests go to ledger@harbor-institute.example.

The unit's fact sheet records that the 1948 "Black Mast Gale" lasted 19 hours in Harbor Town. The unit does not hold material on the 1921 Green Lamp Flood and refers those enquiries elsewhere.
